summary: A lighter live scan, steadier marks, and a clearer caution

groups.title: Live scanning
items: Live scanning rests while you read a still page: it uses about a fifth of the processor it did and costs your browser far less. Any key or mouse move wakes it at once.
Marks on an inbox that repaints without moving now always settle back onto their messages.

groups.title: Colour
items: Caution on light pages is a soft graphite that never outweighs danger.
Warning cards show a full-height mask.
The companion's hover tip shows caution the same way.

groups.title: Speed
items: The Overview opens faster on a first visit, and the web app shows its main content sooner on phones.

groups.title: Motion
items: Animation Off now also stops motion already under way.

groups.title: Blocked pages
items: Continue anyway on a blocked page goes to the address you asked for, and says when your browser may warn once more.

groups.title: Galaxy
items: The galaxy's hold under a resting mouse now scales with the card's size.
